description_for_human: Search, compare, and instantly order from local sweet shops, Blinkit, Zepto, and Amazon with live stock check and Razorpay checkout.
description_for_model: Plugin for autonomous commerce. Search products across multiple providers (local merchants, quick-commerce dark stores, marketplaces), check live warehouse inventory, enforce spending policy limits, generate Razorpay test-mode payment links, and track real-time orders.
